name: tap-desktop
description: Plan release campaigns, draft pitches, check progress and keep contacts tidy in your connected TAP workspace.
long_description: TAP is an agent-assisted music PR platform for independent artists. This extension connects Claude Desktop to your TAP workspace: create or open a campaign, build a contact pool, draft and refine pitches, check outcomes and replies, and keep your contact list tidy. Review and approve your pitches in TAP; TAP sends what you approve.

tools.name: tap_workspace_overview
tools.description: Campaigns, contacts and drafts waiting for approval.

tools.name: tap_list_campaigns
tools.description: List releases or campaigns running in the workspace.

tools.name: tap_get_campaign
tools.description: Release date, status and goal for a named campaign.

tools.name: tap_search_contacts
tools.description: Find a contact id by name or outlet.

tools.name: tap_suggest_contacts
tools.description: Suggest who else to pitch for a release.

tools.name: tap_contact_insights
tools.description: What TAP knows about a contact before pitching.

tools.name: tap_draft_pitch
tools.description: Draft a pitch for one contact.

tools.name: tap_batch_draft_pitches
tools.description: Draft pitches for several contacts at once.

tools.name: tap_list_pitch_drafts
tools.description: Pitches already drafted for a campaign.

tools.name: tap_queue_pitch_review
tools.description: Put a draft in front of the artist for review.

tools.name: tap_get_outcomes
tools.description: Coverage and replies logged for a release.

tools.name: tap_get_approval_queue
tools.description: What is waiting for the artist's approval.

tools.name: tap_update_contact
tools.description: Correct a contact's route, name or detail.

tap_api_key.title: TAP API key
tap_api_key.description: From TAP, under Settings > API Keys (starts tap_ak_). Used to connect this extension to your TAP workspace.
